claim: The freshness check now drops HEAD from the allowed methods, so HEAD requests that previously supported conditional revalidation (304) now always return false/stale, breaking existing callers.

The skip condition is inverted relative to the sibling test below it: this test only runs when shouldSkipQuery returns true (QUERY unsupported), instead of skipping in that case, so it does not exercise the new behavior on environments that actually support QUERY.
